get.summary: Get environment audit logs
get.description: Get feature flag and segment audit logs for a specific environment, with optional filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The part of the keyword/comment of an audit log

parameters.name: CreatorId
parameters.description: The creator id

parameters.name: RefId
parameters.description: The referenced resource id, such as feature flag id or segment id

parameters.name: RefType
parameters.description: The referenced resource type. Can be one of the following: "FeatureFlag" or "Segment"

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The start time of the audit log creation time range, in unix milliseconds

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The end time of the audit log creation time range, in unix milliseconds

parameters.name: CrossEnvironment
parameters.description:
Whether to query logs across environments. By default, we only query logs in the specified environment (the current environment).
Only set this to true if you want to query logs for a shared-segment.

get.summary: Get audit logs by scope
get.description: Query audit logs at the workspace, organization or environment level, with optional filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
Required. Allowed values (case-sensitive): Environment, Organization, Workspace.
Workspace queries are not currently supported and return 403.

parameters.name: ScopeId
parameters.description: Required. The environment, organization or workspace ID corresponding to scope. Must not be an empty GUID.

parameters.name: RefTypes
parameters.description:
Optional. Allowed values (case-sensitive): FeatureFlag, Segment, Member, Group, Policy.
Defaults to the types currently supported by the scope: FeatureFlag and Segment for Environment;
Member, Group and Policy for Organization.
Types must match the scope. Multiple values match any selected type.
Example: refTypes=FeatureFlag&refTypes=Segment.

parameters.name: RefId
parameters.description: Optional resource ID, such as a feature flag or segment ID. Used to get audit logs for a specific resource.

parameters.name: CreatorId
parameters.description: Optional user or access token ID. Omit to query logs from all creators.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Optional text to search for in the log keyword or comment. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Optional inclusive start time, expressed as Unix milliseconds. Omit for no lower time limit.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Optional inclusive end time, expressed as Unix milliseconds. Must not precede from. Omit for no upper time limit.

parameters.name: CrossEnvironment
parameters.description: Only used to query audit logs for a specific shared segment across environments. Defaults to false.
